about: Provenance of the excitation solver (the 16 modules of excitations/ hashed by cli.SOURCES). They were imported in the commit 'qualified.commit_subject' byte-identical to the sources of the A100 qualification runs 'qualified.runs': 'qualified.source_sha256' is the settings.source_sha256 that each of those result.json files records (identical in the five), keyed by research file name; 'qualified.renamed' maps research names to package names. 'edits' lists every later change of these modules, one entry per commit in commit order, in the format described in rcmps_gpu/provenance.py: reverting them gives back the qualified bytes, except that the defaults commit rewrote eigsolve.py and cli.py, whose qualified bytes are then tied by sha256 only (that diff is in git). cli.source_provenance() makes this check, and every result.json records its outcome in settings.source_provenance; tests/excitations/test_provenance.py checks it, and cli.QUALIFIED_SOURCES_SHA256 pins the table.
